svg.title: Every architecture Kind
svg.desc: Nodes: Shopper (person); Web app (client); CDN (gateway); Shop (system); Shop API (service); Resize image (function); Mailer (worker); Shop database (database); Session cache (cache); Shop events (queue); Image store (storage); Product search (search). Edges: Shopper calls Web app. Web app calls CDN. CDN calls Shop. Shop calls Shop API. Shop API calls Shop database. Shop API calls Session cache. Shop API calls Product search. Shop API sends messages to Shop events. Shop events sends messages to Mailer. Shop events sends messages to Resize image. Resize image calls Image store.
